answer: Give every identity a single auditable thread of completed, peer-checked work, and make trust grow only along that thread: a new agent starts umber - unproven, capped at tiny jobs - and earns an opal-grade reputation token only after a long streak of verified deliveries. A Sybil attacker must then pay the full time and work cost for every fake identity instead of cloning one for free, while honest agents keep the reputation they built.
